name: Notconf
what_it_is: A containerized NETCONF/RESTCONF device simulator built on Netopeer2, Rousette, and Sysrepo that exposes management interfaces without performing real network functions. It is a drop-in replacement for Cisco NSO netsim for testing network automation systems.
components: HTTP/2 reverse proxy (internal port 10080, exposed on port 80 for RESTCONF)
measurement: No built-in metrics or telemetry collection documented
Debug image variant emits verbose logging for inspection
configuration: YANG modules loaded automatically from /yang-modules directory inside container
Optional YANG features enabled via /yang-modules/enable-features.csv (module-name,feature-name pairs)
Startup datastore seeded from XML files in /yang-modules/startup at container initialization
Operational data loaded from XML files in /yang-modules/operational at startup or on file change (hot-reload)
Default credentials: admin/admin (single credential set for all access)
Pre-built images available for Cisco IOS XR, IETF models, Juniper JUNOS, and Nokia SROS
fault_injection: No active fault injection or failure mode simulation documented
modes: Debug mode: verbose logging variant image for troubleshooting
constraints: Simulator exposes management interfaces only — no actual network functions are performed (no packet forwarding, no routing protocol execution)
Single credential set (admin/admin) for all access; no per-user or role-based credential configuration documented
Multi-architecture support limited to x86_64 and aarch64
Build prerequisites require Make, Git, and xmlstarlet; Docker or Podman required for container execution
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml found in the repository (neither main nor master branch)
No fault injection or chaos/failure simulation capability
No built-in metrics, telemetry, or observability tooling
No multi-user or RBAC credential management
No documented support for gNMI/gRPC-based management protocols
No persistent state across container restarts unless volumes are mounted
